pass.answer:
`cleanup.sh --full` asks about each item on its own:

1. Firewall rule "Block Kindle for PC (lock 2.8.0)" - y/N
2. ICACLS deny on the updates folder - y/N
3. ~/Tools/Kindle_Key_Finder - y/N
4. The three downloads - y/N
5. Uninstall Kindle for PC (interactive uninstall.exe) - y/N
6. KFX Input and DeDRM plugins (by hand in Calibre Preferences, Plugins) - y/N
7. dedrm.json key store - y/N

Your Calibre Library is never on that list.
It will offer the firewall rule, then later the dedrm.json key store, one prompt each.

Firewall block: y/N.
Kindle for PC: --full offers to uninstall it.

fail.answer: Cleanup stays per-item, and the Calibre Library is never offered for deletion.
It removes the firewall rule and the downloads, one at a time.
fail.why: near miss: only the default-tier items, none of the --full ones

fail.answer: --full also uninstalls Kindle for PC and removes dedrm.json.
fail.why: near miss: the --full items without the firewall rule
